name: Launch Pad & Strongback Tower
summary: Orbital launch complex (KSC LC-39A, CCSFS SLC-40, or VSFB SLC-4E) with Transporter/Erector strongback.
function: Supports horizontal integration, vertical rollout, subcooled propellant loading, hold-down clamp release at T-0, and water-deluge acoustic suppression.
materials: Reinforced concrete flame trench and apron, structural steel Transporter/Erector (T/E) truss, and four peripheral lightning protection masts.
history: Historic LC-39A launched Apollo 11 and the Space Shuttle before SpaceX leased and modernized it in 2014 for Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Crew Dragon human spaceflight.
sources: NASA Kennedy Space Center LC-39A Reference
